narrative.northStar: The Window Into the Living Room
narrative.overview: The profile is not a page of widgets; it is a set of framed windows onto one warm room. The top window shows the wood-panelled wall with the lamp, the TV that reads KEVIN, speakers, the console stand and the vinyl corner; the carpet below holds a smoked-navy glass directory board listing his real projects by floor (Backend, Frontend, Games). The stats cards sit on the same carpet colour, the dock of socials floats as a glass pill, and the lounge window closes the page at the sofa. The world is inherited from homeserverdash and adapted to a medium with no CSS and no JS. GitHub's Markdown sanitizer is the defining constraint. Everything the world needs is baked into committed SVG files that `scripts/build_profile.py` generates, with every letter converted to Archivo outlines, so no font loading, no stylesheet and no theme switching can change what renders. Markdown contributes only layout glue: a centred `div`, `` for the mobile variant, and `` tags. Density is calm and directory-like: ruled hairlines, dotted leaders, big tabular years, expanded caps for signage. One thing moves.
keyCharacteristics: One warm theme: wood wall, navy carpet, cream lettering, lamp amber, an autumn-orange backlight.
Every visual is a generated SVG; text is Archivo outlines, never live text.
Each image is an opaque, rounded, self-contained window that reads the same on GitHub light and dark.
Content is a directory (hairlines, dotted leaders, tabular numerals), not a card grid or badge wall.
The spinning record is the only motion.
Desktop (1000 wide) and compact (600 wide, one column) variants of each scene, switched by `<picture media="(max-width: 640px)">`.

rules.name: The Light Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Autumn and amber appear as glows, halos, rings and one label word. No surface is filled orange.

rules.name: The Same Room Rule
rules.body: Third-party cards are themed onto the carpet through their URL params (carpet background, cream title and text, amber icons, autumn rings, 24px radius, no border). A widget that cannot take these colours does not ship.

rules.name: The Outlines Only Rule
rules.body: Text in the art is set as Archivo glyph outlines (`` references into shared path defs), never ``. GitHub serves SVGs through ``, where web fonts do not load.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Expanded caps label things; normal width names things. Never set a project name in expanded caps, never set signage in normal width.

rules.name: The Twin Scene Rule
rules.body: A scene ships as a 1000-wide and a 600-wide SVG from the same generator functions. The compact one is recomposed, not scaled down.

rules.name: The Shadow Stays Outside Rule
rules.body: Glass surfaces cast their shadow through a mask so the carpet seen through the board is never darkened.

rules.name: The Seamless Dock Rule
rules.body: All dock `` and `` tags sit on one line with no whitespace between them. Any space or newline renders as a gap and splits the pill.

rules.name: The One Motion Rule
rules.body: The turntable is the only animated element in the profile, and it stops under reduced motion. The snake is a separate, external artifact.

dos: Do change the art by editing `scripts/build_profile.py` and regenerating; the generator is the source of truth.
Do build every new scene as an opaque rounded window (24 desktop, 20 compact) so it reads identically on GitHub light and dark.
Do ship a 600-wide compact twin for every full-width scene and switch it with `<picture media="(max-width: 640px)">`.
Do set all art text as Archivo outlines through the Typesetter, expanded caps for signage and normal width for names.
Do theme any third-party card onto the carpet with cream text and autumn or amber accents via its URL params.
Do keep the social links pointing at the platform homepages (and the empty `mailto:`) until Kevin fills in his handles.
Do write a full alt text on each scene image that carries every word the art shows.
donts: Don't hand-edit anything in `assets/`; the next generator run overwrites it.
Don't use `<text>` or reference a web font in the SVGs.
Don't add a light/dark variant or a second theme for the art.
Don't put whitespace or line breaks between dock segments.
Don't add a second animation; the turntable is the only motion and must keep its reduced-motion stop.
Don't invent social handles or drop the dock links.
Don't fill a surface with autumn orange or lamp amber.
Don't return to the README kit: capsule wave banners, typing SVGs, badge walls, quote cards, tokyonight-themed cards.
